import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])

    sum_arr = [0] * 105
    pw = [0] * 105
    p = 1
    mx = 0
    for i in range(100):
        sum_arr[i + 1] = p + sum_arr[i]
        pw[i] = p
        p *= w
        if p > (1 << 40):
            mx = i
            break
    else:
        mx = 99  # if loop completed without break, set mx to last index

    def can(cur, target, pos):
        if cur == target:
            return True
        remaining = sum_arr[pos + 1]
        next_pow = pw[pos]
        if cur - remaining > target:
            return False
        if cur + remaining < target:
            return False
        if cur + sum_arr[pos] < target:
            return can(cur + next_pow, target, pos - 1)
        elif cur - sum_arr[pos] > target:
            return can(cur - next_pow, target, pos - 1)
        else:
            return can(cur, target, pos - 1)

    result = "YES" if can(0, m, mx) else "NO"
    sys.stdout.write(result + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
